display_title:
Hey everyone — quick update regarding Session 1.

We just heard back from Zoom support and unfortunately there was a recording error with the first session, which means we won’t be able to upload the recording into the curriculum.  

We know this isn’t ideal and sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.

To make sure you have what you need, we’ll be posting:
• A full meeting summary
• + the slides we covered during the session

For all the people who couldn’t attend, if you need any additional clarity on the session overview or next steps, please reach out here, and we’ll make sure you’re taken care of.

Thank you for your understanding and patience.
